name: Datfilnoye Leto
source:
Datfeel Summer is not a story about the usual cozy adventures of Semyon, Alisa, Miku, Ulyana, etc. The characters we already know so well simply do not exist in this story. Instead, they've become over-pumped mountains of muscle, the same pioneer girls, only with slightly altered personalities and, of course, appearances...

The story tells of two individuals, to whom fate has presented an unusual version of Sovyonok. What is this pioneer camp hiding? Are our protagonists in danger of suffering in this Sovyonok? Or is it a chance for them to return to reality, making them resort to unusual actions so as not to lose such an opportunity?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1835782848]Steam[/url]]
